If you've never heard of the Enfield Poltergeist then I highly recommend this documentary mainly because the story is fascinating and because this specific documentary interviews all of the key eyewitnesses in the case without sensationalizing the story (much).

It's especially entertaining and refreshing to hear the blunt and brutally honest recounts of Graham Morris (photographer) and Douglas Bence (journalist) as they express their personal opinions and doubts about the claims made by Peggy Hodgson and her daughters, even though the events clearly disturbed them. Mary Rose Barrington (paranormal investigator) is also good value because she essentially takes a crap on everyone.

The Enfield Poltergeist case involved a range of seemingly supernatural occurrences that were focused around two sisters, ages 11 and 13, living at a council house in Brimsdown, Enfield, England from 1977 to 1979.

The Enfield Poltergeist documentary is only slightly longer than an hour and I thoroughly recommend it. Just watch the first few minutes and see what you think...
